notes.moonshotai/kimi-k2.5: OpenRouter Venice endpoint rates, read from the endpoints API on 2026-09-12; routing is pinned to venice and fallbacks are disabled. Rates are a property of the pinned endpoint, not of the model, so this row moves whenever the pin does: the preceding sheet priced deepinfra at 0.45/0.07/2.25 and would under-charge this pin by roughly half on output and threefold on cached input. Venice also serves a 256k context against the 262k the other endpoints offer, which is above anything either arm sends but is the endpoint's limit rather than the model's.
